tags.feature: 1. Added the display of the activity level in the friends list;
2. Added sorting options to friends list and alliance member list;
3. Added the function of multiple selection of “Merge”；
4. Added the function that military units can automatically continue their production, and the default of this function is “off”;
5. Added luminous effect to the “Flower Garden” of Persian civilization;
6. Added the function to input numbers directly when training, building and splitting armies.

tags.balance_change: 1. Adjusted the training resources of certain units;
2. Adjusted the “Angry Slay” skill to one that can be accumulated for multiple times;
3. Adjusted the upper limit of “Reorganize”skill of Imperial General to 10 times;
4. Canceled the reduction in the damage of long-range attacks triggered by the long-range units.

tags.feature: The night view mode is available for all civilizations in Sim Empire.
